description:
Use this tool when the user asks for an account-level overview of Blog2Social API credit usage.

It returns the current credit balance and aggregated usage totals grouped by day, endpoint, and social network.

The optional days parameter must be an integer between 1 and 30. If omitted, the endpoint default applies.

The results describe aggregated account usage. They do not provide performance metrics or analytics for individual published social media posts. Use posts.insights for individual post performance.

days.description: Number of calendar days to include, from 1 to 30.

name: account.overview

credit_usage_total.description: Total number of credits used during the requested period.

title: Retrieve account usage overview
